messages.subject: DIC issue in new version?
parts:
Hi,
In version 22.04.09, I am getting strongly negative values of DIC, for models that had a positive DIC in 22.02.16. Has the calculation changed? For example, for the Scotland lip cancer example, I previously got DIC = 286.546.  In the new version
g = system.file("demodata/scotland.graph", package="INLA")
formula = Counts~f(Region,model="besag", graph.file = g,
                          param=c(0.5,0.0005)) + I(X/10)
mod.scotland = inla(formula,family="poisson",E=E,data=Scotland, control.compute = list(dic=TRUE,waic=TRUE))
summary(mod.scotland)

I get
Deviance Information Criterion (DIC) ...............: -231.45
Deviance Information Criterion (DIC, saturated) ....: -269.17
Effective number of parameters .....................: -231.45
The WAIC hasn't changed.
Thanks,
Beth
